recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11022; future edits to the old certainty extension or reaction-event-certainty code system should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack if Patient Care requests them.
issue_request: FHIR-11022 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 AllergyIntolerance. It asked how the optional AllergyIntolerance.reaction.certainty code unknown differed from omitting certainty, and the accepted resolution defined unknown as an explicit assertion that certainty is not known plus a usage note distinguishing missing certainty from explicit unknown.
initial_application: Historical core commit 87f224c94cabbf01ee3789f815f26c69d05608d4 applied GF#11022 by updating the reaction-event-certainty unknown definition and adding the missing-vs-unknown usage note to the AllergyIntolerance spreadsheet source. The unknown code itself came from the earlier FHIR-10369 change family.
additional_context: FHIR-11020 later moved AllergyIntolerance.reaction.certainty from the base resource into an extension. Current core AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini and now uses AllergyIntolerance.verificationStatus for certainty about the propensity, but the retired reaction.certainty extension and reaction-event-certainty terminology were removed from core during the R5 extension cleanup and now live in the FHIR Extension Pack. The Extension Pack CodeSystem still uses the FHIR-11022 unknown definition, and the allergyintolerance-certainty extension still carries the missing-vs-explicit-unknown comment.
reconciliation: Created an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Reintroducing DSTU2 reaction.certainty text into current core AllergyIntolerance would be obsolete, and no Extension Pack correction is needed for the FHIR-11022 wording.
